Iron ore downside risk flagged amid China rebalancing towards robotics and away from heavy infrastructure; BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' mode; Coalition and Labor both exploring superannuation-to-mortgage pathways, creating policy uncertainty for REITs and banks
Active gold exploration pipeline: Broken Hill lifts SA resource, Great Southern hits 10.72g/t, Platina and Forrestania expand WA ground; silver stunner at Advance (4120g/t)
US-China summit in New York (Trump-Xi) dominates global risk; energy prices dump on Democrat sweep expectations; AUKUS torpedo test signals defence spending continuity
Fiscal concerns: federal/state governments 'careen off debt cliff'; Intergenerational Report locks in mass migration; 'bigger and poorer Australia' narrative gains traction

sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face NIM pressure from rate sensitivity and housing credit risk; REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) vulnerable to rate persistence; monitor super policy shifts

sectors.trend: Energy prices dump on US Democrat sweep expectations; diesel spike concerns; Sempra 20-year LNG deal and Exxon Venezuela return signal long-term supply shifts
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDS.AX, SXG.AX face near-term price headwinds; LNG-linked names benefit from long-term offtake deals; monitor AUD/USD impact on energy exporters

sectors.trend: ASX tech stocks rally on Wall Street surge; AI infrastructure (CoreWeave, Bloom Energy, NVIDIA-SpaceX) driving global momentum; data centres strain net-zero targets

opportunities.rationale: Global AI capex cycle (CoreWeave, NVIDIA-SpaceX, Bloom Energy) driving earnings; ASX tech rallied on Wall Street strength

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight REITs and rate-sensitive financials; favour defensive dividend payers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain AUD/USD hedge on export-heavy positions
defensive_moves.rationale: US-China tensions and Trump trade war create FX volatility; AUKUS defence spending supports AUD but trade risk offsets

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate in a range as rate fears offset tech rally. Iron ore weakness caps materials; housing stress weighs on financials/REITs. Gold miners and tech provide relative outperformance. Expect volatility around US-China summit outcomes and US election signals.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift in China demand (robotics over infrastructure) pressures iron ore/coal majors. Gold and rare earths benefit from geopolitical fragmentation. Housing policy reform (super-to-mortgage) could reshape financial sector over 12 months. AI capex cycle supports tech. Fiscal concerns cap multiple expansion.
